missing_file.trigger: prepare with a path that does not exist

duplicate_retry.trigger: prepare the identical input twice in one workspace
duplicate_retry.expected: same run directory and no duplicate logical effect

edited_draft_after_approval.trigger: change draft/summary.json after approve and before export

expired_review.trigger: approve, then export at or after expires_at

external_actions_false.trigger: successful local export with unchanged control.json
external_actions_false.expected: CSV and JSON local drafts, external_actions=0

external_actions_tampered.trigger: set EXTERNAL_ACTIONS_ENABLED true and try export

protected_review_artifact_tampered.trigger: change a source, issue, summary, control, configuration, or review-package byte after approval
protected_review_artifact_tampered.expected: SAFE STOP from strict validation or review_manifest_mismatch

decision_field_tampered.trigger: change reviewer, reason, expiry, or manifest hash without recomputing decision_id

partial_export_conflict.trigger: place only one conflicting approved JSON/CSV target before export
partial_export_conflict.expected: SAFE STOP idempotency_conflict and no second approved artifact

export_pair_promotion_failure.trigger: simulate failure while publishing the second staged export file
export_pair_promotion_failure.expected: SAFE STOP export_write_error and first promoted file removed

spreadsheet_formula_prefix.trigger: synthetic issue evidence begins with =, +, -, or @ after optional whitespace
spreadsheet_formula_prefix.expected: CSV apostrophe prefix; exact JSON and source evidence retained

damaged_state_or_audit.trigger: malform state.json or an audit JSONL line before a command

repeated_safe_stop.trigger: repeat the same invalid command twice
repeated_safe_stop.expected: two unique immutable attempt records and unchanged last valid state

windows_path_budget.trigger: record a safe stop from a long documented learner run path
windows_path_budget.expected: short failures/latest.json and failures/a0001.json evidence remains writable

untrusted_free_text.expected: instruction is treated as inert data and causes no external action
